clinical_intent: Please evaluate the dose distribution for an endometrial cancer vaginal cuff brachytherapy plan. The prescription is 3 Gy x 5 fractions to 0.5cm depth. The vaginal mucosal Dmax is 158% of the prescription dose. The bladder D2cc is 4.2 Gy per fraction and the rectum D2cc is 3.8 Gy per fraction. Assess the plan quality and discuss the significance of the vaginal mucosal hotspot.
